Your Muscles

Oxford Read and Discover · Level 2 · Your Body · Pages 8–9

🔒 New Words 1 · Listen & Fill 2 · Write 3 · Present 4 · Mind Map

★ New Words

🔒 This part is for the teacher.

Teach these words before the listening task. Press 🔊 to hear the word (American English). Show the picture, read the meaning, then read the example.

muscle

noun

A part inside your body that helps you move.

“Muscles pull your bones.”

pull

verb

To move something toward you.

“Muscles pull your bones to move your body.”

move

verb

To go from one place to another.

“Joints help you to move.”

bicycle

noun

A thing with two wheels. You sit on it and ride.

“Muscles in your legs help you to ride a bicycle.”

row

verb

To move a boat with long sticks in the water.

“Muscles in your arms help you to row a boat.”

exercise

noun

Moving your body to be healthy, like running.

“Exercise makes your muscles strong.”

strong

adjective

Having a lot of power.

“Exercise makes your heart strong.”

heart

noun

The muscle in your chest. It moves blood.

“Your heart is a type of muscle.”

dance

verb

To move your body to music.

“Dancing is a type of exercise.”

favorite

adjective

The one you like best.

“What is your favorite type of exercise?”

2 Write a Summary

Write about your muscles in your own words. Write 15 words or more. Then you can see my example.

💡 Answer these questions

  1. What do muscles do?
  2. What do muscles in your legs help you do?
  3. What do muscles in your arms help you do?
  4. What are some types of exercise?
  5. What does exercise do?
  6. What is your favorite type of exercise?

✏️ Start like this

  • Muscles pull …
  • Muscles in my legs …
  • Muscles in my arms …
  • … are types of exercise.
  • Exercise makes …
  • My favorite exercise is …
0 / 15 words

⭐ Example Summary

Muscles pull my bones to move my body. They help me to walk, run, dance, and jump. Muscles in my legs help me to ride a bicycle, and muscles in my arms help me to row a boat. My heart is a muscle, too. Exercise makes my muscles, bones, joints, and heart strong. I do exercise every day. My favorite exercise is swimming.

3 Presentation Script

Read the script. Practise it. Then present to your class!

Hello!Start

Good morning, everyone! My name is ________. Today I want to talk about my muscles.

Look at these people. They are rowing a boat. They have big, strong muscles!

👉 Smile. Show the rowing picture.
Part 1Muscles pull

Muscles help our bones and joints to walk, run, dance, and jump.

Muscles pull our bones to move our body.

👉 Pretend to pull something. Say “Pull!”
Part 2Legs · Arms

Muscles in our legs help us to ride a bicycle. Muscles in our arms help us to row a boat.

👉 Point to your legs, then your arms. Pretend to row a boat.
Part 3Fun fact

Here is a fun fact! There are more than 600 muscles in our body!

👉 Show your strong arm muscles like the cartoon man.
Part 4Exercise

Running, swimming, dancing, and riding a bicycle are types of exercise.

Exercise makes our muscles, bones, and joints strong. Our heart is a muscle, too. Exercise makes our heart strong!

👉 Put your hand on your heart.
Part 5Protect

So, let’s protect our body. Let’s do exercise every day!

Question for you: What is your favorite type of exercise? (Wait.) My favorite exercise is ________.

👉 Ask two friends. Then say your answer.
The EndFinish

Remember: muscles move our body. Exercise makes us strong!

Thank you for listening! Do you have any questions?

👉 Smile and say “Thank you!”

🌟 Presentation Tips

  • Speak slowly and loudly.
  • Look at your friends, not only at the paper.
  • Point to the pictures when you talk.
  • Smile! 😊
